expectation: Membrane ring on sparse single cells: tissue-resident memory CD8 T cells and intraepithelial lymphocytes sitting in or just under the gut epithelium, plus a few dendritic cells. Rare to moderate density, mostly CD8a-positive, on a clean background.
observed: A: yellow haze over the whole slide, background included, with stripe and bar artefacts. B: diffuse streaky bands with no cell outlines. C: a smooth glow rimming one crypt lumen. D: soft blobs, no membrane rings. E: green forms fibrous or edge-like networks that mostly miss the magenta CD8a cells.
why: The signal is diffuse haze and stripes that follow tissue, not discrete membrane-ringed cells, and it does not sit on CD8a cells.
notes: Haze covers the tissue and background, with stripe artefacts. At cell scale there are no ringed cells, and CD103 in E3 is separate from CD8a cells, tracing edges and fibres instead.
